adaptation: Explicit reader-learning fallback after closed frozen-B0 full-span filter shortfall. The old positive-gain criterion/outcome is retained unchanged; this new supervision pool does not claim to pass it.
scientific_question: Can exact compound calculation supervision teach a prefix-only writer and an I3 reader to produce and use notes on independent real DEV documents?
eligibility: At least2 bounded exact binary arithmetic operations
One representative cut per document from the existing frozen candidate publication
Native original528token source and actual continuation16 unchanged
Verified exact-postorder-v1 note of at most128 content tokens
No likelihood-based acceptance, rejection, ranking or balancing
selection: First5120 eligible compound REPRESENTATIVE documents in the original postorder-note-candidates-v2 publication order. Require5120 unique TRAIN documents; fail on shortfall, do not use duplicate cuts/verbalizations.
teacher_supervision: Future labels choose exact original number surface; symbolic computation uses bounded past expression. Writer inputs end at prefix+native open. Teacher notes are not prefix-generated model outputs.

losses.W: writer mean + note-conditioned natural16 mean +0.5 source mean
losses.T: all-token CE on interleaved augmented source

future_protocol.matched: same source occurrences, seed-specific order and updates; NOT equal labels/FLOPs

endpoints.primary: Terminal heldDEV256 natural16 own-minus-raw and own-minus-intact-other under B0 and self readers; paired document intervals
endpoints.fixed_mixer: .375 extra evaluation control; not mixed-reader training

basis.note: Closed TRAIN diagnostics informed this new design; no claim of prospective selection relative to the old experiment.

runtime_boundary: CPU-only dataset preparation now. No edits to active frozen driver/packer/evaluator dependencies. Scientific training requires completed hardware qualification, reviewed final native inventory/objectives and separate concrete release.

research_context.paper: Reasoning to Learn from Latent Thoughts (BoLT)
research_context.relevant_fact: Trains a shared model on thought-augmented text, with latent placement before or after observed chunks, and warmstarts before importance-resampled EM.
research_context.local_inference: Supports learning a reader jointly with a generator; this exact-symbolic arithmetic experiment does not implement its posterior sampler or EM.

research_context.relevant_fact: Appendix I describes coupling between thought quality and reader/mixer learning, including zero-weight absence of signal and ignoring thoughts when mixing is removed.
research_context.local_inference: A zero-tax oracle is insufficient; fresh own-minus-other under both readers remains necessary. Ordinary I3 SFT can still learn to ignore notes, so this fallback is an empirical test.

research_context.relevant_fact: Concatenates each raw document with its generated thinking trajectory and trains ordinary next-token CE.
research_context.local_inference: Our interleaved calculation-note T arm is a related no-RL comparison, not an exact TPT reproduction; its supervised token budget is much smaller.

publication_note: Design declared before new dataset preparation or scientific training. Closed TRAIN diagnostics informed it; the original filter failure is retained.
